### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **platform-dependent**. `BACKEND` defaults to UCX when compiled with UCX on non-Apple systems, otherwise Gloo.
The YAML `distribute/backend` key is accepted but ignored: the environment wins. Unlike the five scheme flags,
layout options read their environment during option construction.
:::

| environment | default | role |
|---|---|---|
| `PROCESS_RANK` | `RANK`, then 0 | process rank |
| `PROCESS_WORLD_SIZE` | `WORLD_SIZE`, then 1 | process count |
| `WORLD_SIZE` | process world size | global world size |
| `LOCAL_RANK` | 0 | local rank |
| `MASTER_ADDR` | 127.0.0.1 | rendezvous address |
| `MASTER_PORT` | random only for single-process | required for either multi-process size indication |
| `DEVICE`, `DEVICE_ID` | cpu, -1 | device choice |
| `COMMUX_COALESCE`, `COMMUX_GROUP` | 1 if unset | UCX batching |
| `UCX_TLS` | CPU exclusions if unset | excludes CUDA copy/IPC/GDR paths on CPU |
| `WORKSPACE`, `NC_HOME` | current directory, unset | package-build search paths only |


### Derivation

No continuum derivation applies. Rank metadata selects the process topology; block layout and neighbor exchange
then follow it. A common rendezvous port is necessary for processes to join the same group, so automatic port
selection is only admissible for one process.

### Numerical method

Construct layout options, validate rendezvous configuration, then instantiate the compiled process-group backend.
UCX defaults are installed only if absent. These controls affect seam communication, not stencil coefficients;
incorrect rank settings invalidate a multi-rank numerical comparison.

### Limits

No network or multi-rank run is performed. A YAML backend value cannot override the environment at this pin.
Runtime selection of a backend does not prove its library was compiled and linked.

The complete switch inventory is @sec-ch12-matrix.
